【风格】全画面绘画技法严格照 ：透明水彩（transparent watercolor）、湿画法晕染（wet-in-wet）、全幅可见纸纹与颗粒沉淀（paper grain, granulation）、高光处为留白纸底（paper-white reserve）、人物概括为紧凑的剪影色块、几乎无面部细节、边缘在受光处溶解。只从取"怎么画"的笔触与水感，不取其具体内容。不是3D、不是照片写实、不是数码光滑渐变——就是那种透气、颗粒、报道式速写水彩。

【场景】现代巨型航站/登记大厅内部、傍晚。前景：画面左缘一道深色失焦的夹层栏杆/结构梁、呈对角切入（近机位遮挡）。中景：六至七条平行排队通道、铬合金立柱配深蓝伸缩隔离带（stanchion queue lanes）、约一百余名旅客背影密集排队——秋冬大衣、驼色/橄榄/灰褐色调、少数双肩包、散布粉色（~#C99BB0）与芥末黄（~#C9A84C）硬壳拉杆箱；靠窗一侧队列最稀疏。远景：横贯画面上左的长条服务柜台、十余名深色制服职员配淡色显示屏；柜台上方整面深钴蓝横幅（~#2A4B8D）、白色无衬线大写英文"REGISTRATION"、字距宽。右侧四分之一：整面通顶玻璃幕墙、细长拱形肋架（三个拱跨）、矩形竖框网格、被光吞没。地面：大块浅色抛光石材、接缝清晰、靠窗处映出人物柔和倒影。裸露钢桁架天花、左上角渐入近黑。

【机位与纵深】高机位俯视、约30–35度俯角、来自夹层看台；约35mm视感、超宽画幅约21:9；纵深从左下向画面上中方向对角推进、前中后三层清晰；空间锚点：蓝色"REGISTRATION"横幅、位于画面上部左三分之一、偏离中心。

【光线】唯一主光：低角度暖色夕阳光、自画面右侧玻璃幕墙射入（相机方位约3–4点钟、仰角约20–30度）；地面受光处边缘硬朗、窗前一片过曝晕光（bloom）；每个人物与立柱拖出向左的细长投影、影芯冷蓝紫（~#8A8FA8）、随距离边缘渐软；环境补光为高处天光反弹、柔和偏冷、阴影通透可读；画面最亮点：右下空旷地面与玻璃墙本身；最暗点：左上天花角落与左缘栏杆。人物均为背影、无正面受光的脸。

【色调 COLOR 60:30:10】60%暖纸白与羊皮纸色的地面墙面玻璃（~#EDE6D8）；30%人群的去饱和土色——赭褐、橄榄、灰棕（~#6B5D4F）；10%饱和钴蓝——横幅与隔离带（叙事焦点）、辅以粉色与芥末黄行李箱的细小点缀。整体轻盈去饱和、亮部冲至留白、暗部仅存于天花与栏杆、中间调对比温和。

【EYE-LEAD】右侧炽亮窗光 → 顺着地面细长投影向左 → 进入人群色块 → 沿排队通道向纵深 → 停在蓝底白字"REGISTRATION"横幅。

【约束Constraints】画法照、透明水彩、纸纹颗粒、留白高光；超宽21:9、高机位俯视30–35度、左缘深色栏杆前景遮挡、非对称构图、横幅锚点偏左上；唯一光源为右侧玻璃墙低角度夕阳、长投影一律向左、影芯冷蓝紫、无天花灯具光源、无镜头光晕；人物全部背影剪影色块、无清晰面孔、无正面人像；文字仅"REGISTRATION"白色大写无衬线、无其他文字、无水印；蓝色横幅与隔离带为10%叙事акцент、粉黄行李箱点缀；画面内容充实、亮区为水彩留白而非空白背景；不是3D、不是照片写实。

— At the top center, a short green webbing grab handle forms a small upright loop stitched to the top panel.
— Just below the dome, a curved zipper line runs around the upper third of the bag, half-hidden under a narrow flap of the same fabric, its stitched edge visible as a soft horizontal seam.
— Across the middle, a large front pocket panel spans nearly the full width, its top edge a clean horizontal seam with a slight overhang, its own zipper running along the pocket's left side and down toward the lower left corner.
— At the lower left, the pocket zipper ends in a decorative pull: a braided light-green cord strap hanging down in a long plaited loop, joined by a small silver-white clasp ring, from which dangles a small bright yellow rubber star charm with a smiling face.
— On both left and right edges, open elasticated side pockets are formed by gathered pleats of the same green corduroy, curving out slightly from the body.
— Two flat green webbing shoulder straps emerge from behind the bag at the lower left and lower right, curving outward and downward, only their lower portions visible where they pass beyond the silhouette.
— On the lower right side of the bag, a small pale woven label tag with tiny printed lettering is stitched into the side seam.

Three fabric star patches, all five-pointed, applied at different angles and sizes:
— Upper left of the bag: a medium star of pale blue and white gingham check fabric, edged with fine blue embroidered stitching, tilted slightly left.
— Upper right, slightly lower and larger: a star of orange and white checked fabric with a bold orange stitched outline, tilted right.
— Lower center, on the front pocket: a star of dark purple and magenta checked fabric with a bright pink stitched outline, tilted left.
Each patch shows the woven check pattern clearly and a neat satin-stitch border where it meets the corduroy.

Soft even light from the front and slightly above, gentle shading down both sides of the bag and a subtle shadow under the front pocket flap, ribs highlighted across the center. Plain pure white background, no floor line, no props, no shadow beneath. Square composition, the backpack centered and filling most of the frame with even white margin around it.

A cartoon four-pointed metal throwing star (shuriken) shown flat and face-on, centered in a square frame on a plain white background, seen straight from above with no tilt and no perspective — the exact same geometry as a technical shuriken plate, but drawn as a bold, clean cartoon object.

THE SHAPE (kept exactly):
A flat plate of even thickness with four long, very slender blades radiating diagonally toward the four corners of the frame — up-left, up-right, down-left, down-right. Each blade tapers from a wide root to a needle-sharp point, the points reaching almost to the frame corners, giving a tall, thin, cross-like star silhouette rather than a compact one. Perfect four-fold symmetry, upright and balanced.
Between every pair of adjacent blades the outline cuts inward in a deep concave semicircular notch — at top, bottom, left and right — each notch with a smooth rounded rim curving into the blade roots on either side.
At the exact center, a large round open through-hole with a raised collar ring around it; the white background shows cleanly through the opening.
Each blade keeps its two-plane construction: a broad flat central face and a narrow angled bevel strip running the full length of both edges, with a short widened shoulder facet where the bevel meets the body.

CARTOON TREATMENT:
Thick, confident black outlines around the whole silhouette, around the center hole and around every notch, with slightly thinner internal lines marking the bevel strips and shoulder facets — a clean inked look with a hint of line-weight variation, heavier on the outer contour, lighter inside.
Flat color fills instead of smooth gradients: three or four simple grey tones only — a light silver-grey for the upper-left blade faces, a mid grey for the lower-right faces, a darker cool grey for all bevel strips, and a soft grey ring inside the center collar. Hard-edged boundaries between tones, no soft blending, no noise, no reflections.
Two or three simple stylized highlights: a bold white streak running along the upper-left blade, a short white wedge near the top of the collar ring, and a small white spark glint at one blade tip. Corners very slightly softened so the shape reads friendly rather than hyper-technical, but the points stay sharp.

COMPOSITION:
Square frame, the star centered, its four points nearly touching the corners, plain flat white background with no floor, no horizon, no cast shadow — or at most a simple flat grey shape offset slightly down-right as a graphic drop shadow.

A four-pointed metal throwing star (shuriken) shown flat and face-on, centered in a square frame against an empty white background, seen straight from above with no tilt or perspective.

THE SHAPE:
A single flat plate of even thickness with four long, extremely slender blades radiating diagonally toward the four corners of the frame — up-left, up-right, down-left, down-right. Each blade tapers from a wide root at the body to a needle-fine sharp point, the points reaching almost to the frame corners, giving a tall thin cross-like silhouette rather than a compact star. The whole form is perfectly symmetrical, upright and balanced.

BLADE DETAIL:
Every blade has one long straight leading edge and one slightly swept trailing edge. A narrow flat ground bevel runs the full length of both edges, separating a broad flat central face from the sharpened rim, so each arm reads as three distinct planes: bright flat face, darker angled bevel, and the razor edge line. Near each blade root the bevel widens into a short angled shoulder facet that steps down into the central body.

THE BODY:
Between the four blades the outline cuts inward in four deep concave semicircular notches — at top, bottom, left and right — each with a smooth raised rounded rim that curves into the blade roots on either side. At the exact center is a large round open through-hole, its edge finished with a raised polished collar ring; the white background shows cleanly through the opening.

SURFACE AND SHADING:
Smooth machined metal with a soft grey gradient across the flat faces, darker cool grey on the beveled strips, a slightly brighter sheen along the raised rims of the notches and the collar around the center hole. Thin crisp dark outlines define every edge and facet boundary. No scratches, no texture, no engraving, no color — just clean grey metal tones from mid-grey to near white.

LIGHT AND COMPOSITION:
Soft even light from the upper left, gentle tonal separation between the upper-left and lower-right blades, no cast shadow on the background. Square frame, the star centered, its four points nearly touching the corners, plain flat white background with no floor, horizon or reflection.

A high-rise concrete building under construction with a tower crane beside it and a finished city around them, shot from ground level looking up, tall vertical frame, monochrome black and white.

THE BUILDING UNDER CONSTRUCTION (left and center):
An unfinished multi-storey reinforced concrete tower occupying the left two thirds and center of the frame, seen from a corner so two facades recede — the broad left face nearly frontal, the right face angling away into depth. Roughly fourteen visible floors stacked in a strict grid: horizontal cast concrete slab edges running the full width, vertical columns and shear walls dividing each level into open bays. Every bay is a dark empty rectangular opening with no glazing, no window frames and no infill, revealing shadowed interior floor plates, columns behind, and daylight passing through from the far side in places. A tall solid concrete core wall runs down the left edge, blank and windowless, broken only by narrow slot openings. Along several floors, temporary horizontal steel guard rails and scaffold pipes span the open bays, with short pieces of timber formwork and stacked boards on the slab edges.

THE ROOF LEVEL:
The top floor is mid-pour: rows of vertical steel reinforcement bars protrude from the unfinished walls along the roof edge, upright plywood and steel formwork panels stand in a line, a section of wall shuttering rises at the left corner, a low temporary railing runs along the perimeter, a large flat prefabricated panel leans against the left corner and a small dark machine unit sits near the middle of the deck.

THE FINISHED RESIDENTIAL BUILDING (right):
On the right side of the frame stands a completed high-rise apartment block, similar in height, seen at a slight angle. Its facade is a regular grid of finished windows with dark reflective glazing and pale frames, balconies with solid parapets stepping across several bays, air-conditioning units on brackets, and a flat parapet roof with antenna masts and a lift overrun box. The lower floors carry a plainer plinth with a canopy over an entrance. Its surfaces are clean and uniform, contrasting with the raw grey shell to the left.

THE CRANE (between the two buildings):
A tall tower crane stands in the gap directly between the unfinished tower and the finished apartment block, rising from the site between them. Its slender lattice mast is a vertical column of cross-braced steel running from ground level, past both roofs, to the top of the frame, with a ladder cage and platform sections along it. At the top, the operator cab and turntable, and a long horizontal jib extending diagonally across the entire upper left of the frame to the top left corner — an open triangular lattice of chords and diagonal struts tapering toward the tip, passing above the roof of the building under construction. A short counter-jib with a heavy rectangular counterweight block projects to the right, over the finished building. A trolley sits partway along the jib with two thin hoist cables hanging straight down in a long vertical line into the roof area below, hook out of sight. A few small bright work lights glow along the jib and mast.

THE CITY AROUND:
Beyond and between the two towers, a dense city skyline fills the middle distance — several completed residential and office blocks of varying heights stacked back into depth, their window grids growing smaller and hazier with distance, flat roofs bristling with vents, aerials and satellite dishes. A second, smaller tower crane stands far back on the left horizon, a thin silhouette against the sky. At the lower right and left, closer mid-rise blocks and the tops of low buildings crowd in, partly cropped by the frame edges, with a strip of denser urban clutter running along the base of the towers.

FOREGROUND RIGHT:
At the lower right, a lower unfinished section of the same development crosses the frame — open concrete floors with scaffold rails and a long horizontal signage band along its edge. In front of it stands a road sign on a post: a light rectangular board with an upward arrow and Cyrillic text "ВЕРХНЯЯ ПЫШМА" with the number "1.8" at its right, and below a second board with a left arrow and smaller Cyrillic text "ЖК РАДИОСТАНЦИЯ".
At the very bottom left corner, the dark blurred silhouette of tree foliage intrudes slightly into the frame.

SKY AND TONE:
A completely clear, empty sky filling the upper portion, smoothly graded from light mid-grey at the top to paler grey near the skyline, with no clouds. Everything rendered in greyscale: pale luminous sky, mid-grey concrete faces, near-black window voids, dark crane lattice silhouetted against the light sky, distant buildings lighter and hazier with atmospheric falloff.

LIGHT AND COMPOSITION:
Soft flat daylight, low in intensity, structures read mostly as masses of tone and edge. Tall vertical composition: the crane jib slicing diagonally across the top, the crane mast dividing the frame between the raw concrete tower on the left and the finished apartment block on the right, the city skyline filling the middle band, the towers running off the bottom edge.

A wide 16:9 horizontal frame of an empty sunny sky, split into two clear horizontal zones with no ground, no horizon line, no objects and no subjects anywhere.

UPPER 60% — OPEN BLUE SKY:
The top three fifths of the frame is clear open sky, deepest and most saturated cobalt blue along the very top edge and in the upper right corner, gradually lightening downward through azure into a pale, milky sky-blue as it approaches the middle of the frame. The gradient is smooth and even, with no clouds interrupting the upper right and center areas.
In the upper left, positioned roughly one fifth in from the left edge and one fifth down from the top, sits a brilliant white sun: a small intensely bright core blown out to pure white, surrounded by a soft round halo of white glow that fades into the blue, and a starburst of long straight rays radiating outward in all directions — about a dozen thin needle-like spikes of varying length, the longest reaching down and to the right across the upper left quadrant, some faint and thin, others broader and brighter. Faint diagonal light shafts extend from the sun toward the center of the frame, and a few tiny specks of lens sparkle sit along their path.

LOWER 40% — CLOUD FIELD:
The bottom two fifths of the frame is filled with a broad bank of soft white cumulus cloud, forming a continuous mass that spans the full width. Its upper boundary is uneven and billowing: rounded puffy cauliflower lobes rise higher in two places — a cluster of cotton-like domes at the left edge just under the sun, catching bright rim light on their upper curves and holding pale blue-grey shading in their hollows, and a second larger crisply defined bank at the right, with layered rounded tops and soft shadowed undersides. Below that boundary the cloud mass turns progressively softer and flatter, all definition dissolving into a smooth, even, glowing white haze that fills the entire bottom of the frame with no texture, no edges and no detail — a clean, bright, empty white field suitable for placing text or a subject over it.

Wide 16:9 aspect ratio, symmetrical and balanced, sun as the only accent in the upper left, the cloud line crossing the frame at exactly 60% height, the lower 40% left open and empty.

A giant character balloon — a huge helium parade balloon built in the shape of a cartoon yellow dog — floating alone against a completely plain white background.

IT MUST READ AS A BALLOON, NOT A FIGURE:
Every body part is an obvious inflated air-filled volume. Nothing is sculpted, everything is blown up and rounded until it is tight and bulging. Cartoon proportions throughout: oversized head, barrel torso, stubby thick limbs, mitten paws with no separated toes, no sharp edges anywhere in the whole object.

BALLOON EVIDENCE ON EACH BODY PART:
Head — a large wedge-shaped inflated volume built from curved gore panels, seams running from the crown down to the muzzle, the long snout a separate sewn tube ballooning forward.
Nose — a big black inflated bulb stitched onto the tip of the muzzle with a puckered ring seam, a white oval highlight printed on it.
Eyes — flat printed graphics on the curve of the head, distorting slightly over the bulge; the heavy upper eyelids are separate sewn-on puffed crescents.
Ears — two floppy inflated tubes hanging from the sides of the head, wide at the top, tapering to rounded tips, each with a center seam and a ragged printed scallop edge.
Neck — a short inflated ring almost swallowed by the head and chest.
Torso — a fat rounded barrel; the pale belly panel is a separate sewn oval patch with a visible raised seam around it.
Arms — sausage tubes with a pinched crease at the elbow; the raised thumbs-up paw is a single rounded knob with only shallow indented lines suggesting fingers, the thumb a small separate inflated lobe.
Lower paw — a puffed mitten resting against the hip, seamed at the wrist.
Legs and feet — short thick cylinders ending in bulbous rounded feet with a horizontal ankle seam and shallow printed toe lines.
Tail — a long inflated tapering tube curving upward behind the body, tipped with a separate brown sewn panel.
Everywhere — coated ripstop nylon with a satin sheen: broad soft highlights rolling over each bulge, gentle gradient shading beneath, fine radial stretch wrinkles fanning from every seam, small puckers where panels meet.

TETHER LINES AND RIGGING:
Many thin white nylon ropes hang down from the balloon. Stitched webbing loops with steel D-rings at both wrists, both ankles, the base of the tail, the collar and the back of the neck; from each ring a slender white line runs downward out of the bottom of the frame, some taut, some slack and curving, crossing at shallow angles. The fabric puckers into small dimples at every anchor point. A bridle of several lines converges under the chest. A small inflation valve with a fabric flap is sewn near the lower back.

POSE:
Floating upright and tilted slightly back as if drifting, body facing three-quarters left, head lifted and turned up in profile with a smug closed-mouth grin, one front paw raised in a big thumbs-up, the other paw resting on the hip, hind feet hanging below.

A cartoon dog in bright saturated yellow. Long rectangular muzzle with a few printed freckle dots and short whisker lines on the snout; large glossy black nose bulb with a white highlight; small black eyebrow marks above heavy-lidded eyes with a lazy confident expression; wide curving smile line along the jaw. Ears in warm orange with a darker outline, hanging long past the jaw with a slightly frayed printed edge. A pale cream oval belly patch on the chest and stomach. Around the neck a wide royal blue collar band with a row of large round silver studs across it, sewn on as a raised separate ring. Tail yellow with a brown tip. COMPOSITION & FRAMING:
Ultra-wide 107-degree interior view of a vintage taxi rear passenger cabin, shot from low front-seatback height. In the center, a slender teenage girl passenger sits on the dark olive-green textured velour bench. She is caught in mid-motion sliding toward the right door, both hands frantically clutching the overhead grab handles. 

CHARACTER & ATTRIBUTES:
Teenage girl with chest-length loose ginger-red hair trailing dynamically to the left, wide comic-panic eyes, freckles, wearing an oversized blue zip hoodie with a red "N" patch, beige pleated mini-skirt, slouchy white knee socks, red high-top sneakers, and white over-ear headphones resting around her neck. A boarding pass corner pokes from her hoodie pocket.

LIGHTING & ATMOSPHERE (GOLDEN HOUR ARC):
Dramatic low-angle golden hour sunlight streams from the rear-left through the wide back window and side glass, casting warm amber horizontal shafts across the grey-blue headliner and olive-green seats. Her ginger hair catches a radiant glowing golden-red rim light against deep, cool violet-indigo shadows. Subtle Tyndall dust beams inside the cabin.

OUTSIDE WORLD THROUGH WINDOWS:
Through the rear and side glass, a multi-lane highway speeds backward with streaking white dashed lines, guardrails, and passing cars bathed in warm sunset hues. Horizon stays completely flat and level.

ART STYLE LOCK:
Expressive watercolor on rough cold-press paper texture, visible granulation in deep shadows, delicate ink line contours with organic vibration, wet-on-wet watercolor washes, stylized animation aesthetic. No 3D CGI gloss, no photorealism, no text.

电影光基座（锁定——全片唯一灯位、方向与色温永不变）
主光：黄金时刻低角度暖阳、从左后上方射入、穿过左侧车窗与后窗带低角度打进舱内、在灰蓝顶棚、墨绿绒座与她身上落下细长硬边的暖光条、全部向右下方倒。冷暖劈分：受光面暖琥珀金、背光面冷蓝紫、明暗交界水彩笔触强调。轮廓光：她的长发外缘、肩线与座椅冠部每一帧带后窗来的暖轮廓边——姜红色长发在逆光里烧成一圈金红、这是全片最美的光效；阴影侧留冷轮廓。大气：细丁达尔光束穿窗、光束里尘埃发亮、低阳扫过玻璃处泛柔和辉光。玻璃：车窗带手绘高光与克制的光斑之吻、窗外世界透过光幕仍可读。反弹：暖光从绒面反弹托亮她的下颌底与膝盖、朝上的面接冷天光补。漂移中的光：车平偏航——光条绝不倾斜、而是随漂移在顶棚与座面上水平滑转、像慢速灯塔；平直段灯柱以恒定节拍把主光切成频闪。事件光：每辆被超车掠过投一片色影（红、橙、灰）横扫舱内；每次拉紧时一道暖光条压暗在她绷直的手臂上；第二次撞击后光条扫离她的脸半秒——纯金逆光剪影、发丝金边全亮、随即回光。阴影：长、有方向、透明多层水彩、永不死黑；她的脸、手与断柄任何曝光下可读；无第二光源、无平补、无中性白昼光。
车辆状态（平漂移铁律+永不停车铁律）
车从第一帧到最后一帧以持续高速行驶并漂移——绝不停车、绝不刹停、绝不怠速、绝不减速到慢行；最后一帧公路仍在全速后掠。方向变化只靠平贴地面的漂移：偏航+车尾横滑、悬挂水平——窗内地平线全程水平（浮动≤2–3度）、绝不船式侧倾；读法：后窗道路轴线随车尾甩出水平旋转、侧窗景物弧形横扫、胎底砂砾擦滑震颤；横向G甩的是舱内的人与物、不是地平线。窗外： 地理在黄金时刻调色下 12 秒不停后掠（含最后定格拍）、方向永远从前到后、灯柱频闪到最后一帧；漂移时后掠拉成水平弧形涂痕、漂完恢复清晰四层景深（虚线最快、护栏树带中速、远山塔楼缓、琥珀天与云几乎不动）。超车几何：每辆被超车先在侧窗旁清晰并行整一拍（真实水彩车、金顶、长长右下投影）、随后滑入后窗、变成朝我们的车头、稳定缩小成色点并留驻、绝不再追近；任何一帧任何一扇窗不得空白、不得白板、不得纯色。
舱内运动逻辑
层级：车先动 → 她的质量加载 → 长发、裙摆、耳机、断柄最迟。她没系安全带、真实重量的身体、一切位移只由漂移横向力驱动；撞门时全身压扁一拍（脸颊挤变形、四肢摊开）再弹回；吊在把手上时是真钟摆——支点在支架、弧线由横向加速度驱动。断裂铁律：她绝不主动拉拽——拳头只是没松开；支架只在"拉紧"拉满之后、被她全身吊挂的体重剪断；断柄留在拳中、有重量地甩摆、绝不消失绝不复原。
她的四件"活物"（各有各的物理、永不同步）：
长发——姜红长发是全片最大的跟随物：每次横飞整头发向反方向甩成一面扇、撞击瞬间罩住半张脸、迟身体 3–5 帧才落；吊挂时发梢垂向低侧；额前呆毛永远最后一个安定。
耳机——挂在脖子上的白色头戴耳机随每次撞击在锁骨上弹跳一下、猛甩时滑到肩头再滑回、绝不飞脱、绝不戴上耳朵。
裙摆——米色百褶裙每次横飞掀起波浪褶、落座时压平反弹；堆堆袜在小腿上微微下滑一格。
登机牌——口袋里那角纸片每次猛甩扑扑翻动、绝不飞出。
每次断裂一颗螺丝抛物线弹跳滚过脚垫；任何两件散物不同步。
首帧
第一帧即定稿静帧：车已在漂移入弯、金色光条横躺在绒座上、舱体水平、后窗道路轴线已被车尾甩得微微旋转；她正滑向右门、右手紧攥右侧车顶把手、红色帆布鞋底在脚垫上打滑、瞪眼望向右窗——红轿车正清晰并行在一米外、车顶烧着暖金；她的姜红长发拖向左、发梢燃着后窗来的金边、耳机贴在锁骨上、裙褶被横向力掀起一角；两只把手完好；丁达尔光束里尘埃悬浮。
摄影机
呼吸式手持：机位固定在前排椅背后、低位、舱轴正中、朝后拍全排；超广角 107 度、距座约 1 米——两扇门与两只把手永远在画内；她与她正加载的把手清晰、窗外柔和拉丝但被超车可读。持续轻柔漂浮、缓慢微推微拉；每次漂移镜头被惯性带得迟半拍向反方向水平拖拽（荷兰角封顶 2–3 度）、过冲后缓缓找平；每段拉紧缓慢推向绷直的手臂；每次剪断一记细微震颤；结尾缓缓后拉——但路面震颤全程满载。无剪辑、无变焦、无甩镜、永不剧烈晃动。
动作时间轴（逐步分解——每一步写明：车 / 窗外 / 她 / 物 / 光 / 声）
【第一拍·超车一 0.0–2.0s】
步骤1（0.0–0.8）：车——全速直行、细碎路颤。窗外——右侧窗里红轿车清晰并行在一米外、车顶金光、投影拖向右下；后窗金色路面全速后掠、虚线吸进车底。她——半坐半撑在座面右侧、右手攥住右把手、左手撑座、眼睛盯着红轿车、长发随路颤轻轻浮动。光——光条随灯柱频闪扫过顶棚。声——路噪、风声、旁车引擎并行声。
步骤2（0.8–2.0）：车——开始压向左道准备切线。窗外——红轿车相对我们向后滑动、从侧窗滑入后窗、变成朝我们的车头、开始缩小。她——身体随预备的微沉轻轻向左倾半拍、发梢先摆。光——红轿车掠过时一片淡红色影横扫舱内一秒。声——第一记多普勒呼啸由近而远。
【第二拍·左漂入弯 2.0–3.0s】
步骤3（2.0–2.4）：车——车尾向左甩出、进入平漂移。窗外——后窗道路轴线开始水平旋转、侧窗景物弧形横扫、拉成水平涂痕。她——横向G把她从座面甩起、身体向右门方向滑动、右手在把手上从"扶"变成"抓"、长发整面甩向左。光——光条在顶棚上向右水平滑转。声——胎底砂砾擦滑长音起。
步骤4（2.4–3.0）：车——漂移角稳定、持续滑行。窗外——旋转持续、红点在后窗继续缩小。她——双脚离开脚垫、体重完全转移到右臂、裙褶掀起、耳机滑到左肩头。镜头——迟半拍向左水平拖拽、2 度荷兰角、开始缓缓找平。
【第三拍·拉紧一 3.0–4.4s】
步骤5（3.0–3.6）：她——整个人吊在右把手上、身体向左下拉成一条长斜线、红帆布鞋尖擦着座面拖行、把手带绷直、长发与裙摆全部垂向左低侧、发梢在金光里燃成一线。物——支架开始吱嘎、顶棚布围着螺丝出现放射状褶皱。光——一道暖光条恰好压暗在她绷直的小臂上。声——吱——嘎——第一段、她一声小小呜咽。
步骤6（3.6–4.4）：她——眼睛从窗外慢慢爬向头顶支架——大事不妙；全身重量持续吊拽。物——把手肉眼可见地弯了几度、褶皱加深、吱嘎声升高。镜头——缓慢推向她绷直的手臂、屏住呼吸。悬念拍——拉长它、让观众等。
【第四拍·剪断一+横飞+撞左门 4.4–5.2s】
步骤7（4.4–4.45，单帧）：物——支架剪断：断口迸出一小蓬水彩碎屑、一颗螺丝抛物线飞出。她——手臂猛然卸力。声——干脆金属"咔嚓"。镜头——一记细微震颤。
步骤8（4.45–4.9）：她——带着断柄横飞过舱、沿对角弧线、长发在身后拉成一整面姜红的扇、最快 1–2 帧以手绘涂抹帧呈现。窗外——左侧窗里橙色小掀背车已清晰并行进入画面。
步骤9（4.9–5.2）：她——砸上左门：全身贴板压扁一拍、脸颊挤变形、长发罩住半张脸、耳机在锁骨上弹跳一下、随即弹回；短促惊呼"Ouch!"、一甩头把头发甩开；断柄锁在右拳、随自身重量甩摆两下。物——螺丝落在脚垫上叮当滚动。声——闷响+惊呼+螺丝声。
【第五拍·看+抢抓 5.2–6.4s】
步骤10（5.2–5.7）：她——从门板剥离、坐起半拍、拨开脸上的姜红发帘、举起右拳愣看拳中的断柄——什么情况。窗外——橙色小车从侧窗滑入后窗、缩成橙点、与红点并排。
步骤11（5.7–6.4）：她——抬起一条清晰可读的视线、望向对面完好的左把手（视线拍必须读到）——随即猛扑过去、左手钩死左把手、断柄仍攥在右拳、长发甩过肩头跟上。光——光条随车身回正在顶棚上缓缓滑回。
【第六拍·右漂+拉紧二 6.4–7.6s】
步骤12（6.4–6.8）：车——车尾反向甩出、右漂入弯。窗外——后窗道路轴线水平转回另一侧、侧窗涂痕反向横扫；右侧窗里小货车清晰并行进入。她——被反向G甩离左门、体重挂上左臂、长发整面反甩向右。声——擦滑长音更长。
步骤13（6.8–7.6）：她——吊在左把手上、身体反向拉成长斜线、带子绷直、裙摆与发梢垂向右低侧、耳机滑到右肩。物——支架吱嘎声更高更长、褶皱更深、把手弯得更明显。她——抬眼看支架——"不会又来吧"——悬念比第一次多憋一拍。光——暖光条压暗在左臂上。镜头——迟拍右拖、缓推左臂。声——吱嘎二段+第二声小呜咽。
【第七拍·剪断二+横飞+撞右角 7.6–8.5s】
步骤14（7.6–7.65，单帧）：物——第二支架剪断、更响："咔嚓！"、碎屑、第二颗螺丝蹦跳。镜头——震颤。
步骤15（7.65–8.1）：她——横飞回右侧、对角弧线、姜红长发再拉成满幅的扇、最快 1–2 帧涂抹帧。窗外——小货车滑入后窗缩小。
步骤16（8.1–8.5）：她——砸进右角座面、压扁弹起、拖长的惊呼"哇——啊！"；两拳各攥半截把手、头发彻底炸开罩脸。光——光条恰好扫离她的脸半秒——纯金逆光剪影、发丝金边全亮、随即回光。声——闷响+惊呼+螺丝叮当。
【第八拍·回线不减速 8.5–9.5s】
步骤17（8.5–9.0）：车——车尾收直、回到车道、但全速丝毫不减：虚线以同样速率吸进车底、灯柱照旧频闪、风声照旧轰鸣。窗外——后窗道路轴线摆回正中、红橙灰三点一字排开仍在缩小。
步骤18（9.0–9.5）：她——惯性把她抛回座面正中、软弹一下落定；长发扇形散开、一缕缕落定、呆毛最后弹两下。镜头——找平、呼吸放缓——但路面震颤满载。
【第九拍·只有她定格、车绝不减速 9.5–12.0s】
步骤19（9.5–10.5）：她——瘫坐正中、透过散乱的姜红发帘、举起左拳看看、举起右拳看看——两截断柄；耳机歪挂在锁骨一侧。窗外——金色世界以不减的速度掠过每一扇窗。
步骤20（10.5–11.3）：她——吹开嘴前的一缕头发、抬头看顶棚上两个光秃秃的螺丝孔、小声倒吸一口气。物——两截断柄在她拳中相磕一声。光——光条照旧频闪扫过。
步骤21（11.3–12.0）：她——额前呆毛穿过一道发光的丁达尔光束缓缓立回原位。车——照旧全速：卡扣嗡颤、三点继续缩小、虚线继续吸进车底。镜头——极轻微缓缓后拉收束。最后一帧仍在飞驰途中——绝不是停车。
物理
车：平漂移——偏航+车尾横滑、悬挂水平、地平线浮动≤2–3度；前进速度全程保持、回线不掉速、全片无任何刹车事件。她：真实重量、只被漂移G驱动、绝不自行漂浮滑动。断裂：每次都只在拉紧拉满之后、由她全身吊挂的体重剪断支架、她从不主动拉拽。断柄有重量——甩摆、相磕一声、最迟落定。长发有重量有惯性——甩扇、罩脸、迟 3–5 帧落定、绝不穿模绝不僵硬；耳机贴颈弹跳、绝不飞脱；裙摆掀起必落回。被超车并行时轮速与车速一致、后窗里只缩不放、无一物瞬移。最快动作以手绘涂抹帧呈现、绝不用均匀 CG 运动模糊。
音频（拟音+惊呼、无对白无音乐）
舱内路噪、胎鸣与风声——从第一帧到最后一帧满载全速强度、绝不减弱得像在减速；每段漂移下砂砾擦滑长音；三次超车贴身呼啸骤远（多普勒）；两段长长的支架吱嘎（第二段更高更长）各终结于一记干脆金属"咔嚓"（第二记更响）；两下贴板闷响各配她一声短促惊呼——"Ouch!"、拖长的"哇——啊！"——每段拉紧各一声小小呜咽；耳机在锁骨上轻磕两声、螺丝叮当、断柄相磕、结尾吹发一声轻"呼"加小声倒吸气。
正向锁定

步骤19（9.5–10.5）：她——瘫坐正中、透过散乱的姜红发帘、举起左拳看看、举起右拳看看——两截断柄；耳机歪挂在锁骨一侧。窗外——金色世界以不减的速度掠过每一扇窗。
步骤20（10.5–11.3）：她——吹开嘴前的一缕头发、抬头看顶棚上两个光秃秃的螺丝孔、小声倒吸一口气。物——两截断柄在她拳中相磕一声。光——光条照旧频闪扫过。
步骤21（11.3–12.0）：她——额前呆毛穿过一道发光的丁达尔光束缓缓立回原位。车——照旧全速：卡扣嗡颤、三点继续缩小、虚线继续吸进车底。镜头——极轻微缓缓后拉收束。最后一帧仍在飞驰途中——绝不是停车。
物理
车：平漂移——偏航+车尾横滑、悬挂水平、地平线浮动≤2–3度；前进速度全程保持、回线不掉速、全片无任何刹车事件。她：真实重量、只被漂移G驱动、绝不自行漂浮滑动。断裂：每次都只在拉紧拉满之后、由她全身吊挂的体重剪断支架、她从不主动拉拽。断柄有重量——甩摆、相磕一声、最迟落定。长发有重量有惯性——甩扇、罩脸、迟 3–5 帧落定、绝不穿模绝不僵硬；耳机贴颈弹跳、绝不飞脱；裙摆掀起必落回。被超车并行时轮速与车速一致、后窗里只缩不放、无一物瞬移。最快动作以手绘涂抹帧呈现、绝不用均匀 CG 运动模糊。
音频（拟音+惊呼、无对白无音乐）
舱内路噪、胎鸣与风声——从第一帧到最后一帧满载全速强度、绝不减弱得像在减速；每段漂移下砂砾擦滑长音；三次超车贴身呼啸骤远（多普勒）；两段长长的支架吱嘎（第二段更高更长）各终结于一记干脆金属"咔嚓"（第二记更响）；两下贴板闷响各配她一声短促惊呼——"Ouch!"、拖长的"哇——啊！"——每段拉紧各一声小小呜咽；耳机在锁骨上轻磕两声、螺丝叮当、断柄相磕、结尾吹发一声轻"呼"加小声倒吸气。
正向锁定
单一连续镜头；出租车在每一帧（含最后一帧）都以持续高速行驶并漂移、绝不停车绝不刹停、结尾必须在飞驰途中——最后一帧若窗外静止或车已停下即为废片；最后一拍只有少女定格、窗外世界照旧全速流动、光条照旧频闪、舱体照旧震颤；平漂移铁律——舱体与窗内地平线全程水平（≤2–3度）、方向变化只以窗外世界的水平旋转与车尾横滑呈现、绝不车身侧倾；两次断裂必须严格按步骤走完（长拉紧：吱嘎+褶皱+弯曲 → 单帧剪断 → 横飞 → 撞击压扁弹回）、她绝不主动拉拽、断后顶棚各留光秃螺丝孔、断柄留拳中不消失不复原；步骤10–11的"看断柄→看对面把手"视线拍必须可读；三辆被超车各按 、、 同款、先侧窗清晰并行一拍、再退入后窗缩成留驻色点、永远从前到后、绝不从后方出现；所有车窗每一帧填满 地理在黄金时刻调色下的四层景深、任何窗不得空白不得纯色；电影光锁定——全片唯一黄金时刻低阳从左后上方、硬光条向右下、冷暖劈分、她的姜红长发每帧带金红轮廓光、丁达尔光束与尘埃、频闪节拍到最后一帧、无第二光源无平补无中性白昼光；她全程 同款——姜红长直发、蓝色"N"字连帽衫、米色百褶裙、白堆堆袜、红色高帮帆布鞋、颈挂白色耳机（耳机绝不飞脱绝不戴上）、口袋登机牌绝不飞出；镜头呼吸式漂浮、水平迟拖、荷兰角≤3度、无剪辑无变焦、永不剧烈晃动；后舱必须 同款但以黄金光重照；全片水彩画法统一 ；画面干净清晰、不添加任何文字或水印。

Aerial view from a pedestrian overpass looking down a six-lane urban highway
that recedes into the distance, vanishing point in the upper third. Wide
asphalt roadway split by a central grass median and metal guardrail; near
carriageway nearly empty, far carriageway filled with cars, a box truck and
a yellow school bus. White dashed lane markings, solid yellow line along the
inner edge. A row of tall lamp posts runs along the median. Both sides of the
road are steep green slopes densely covered with deciduous trees and shrubs;
grassy embankment on the left, a single-track railway on gravel ballast and
electricity pylons behind the trees on the right. Beyond the treetops, a city
skyline: a tall residential tower on a hill at the right, industrial buildings
and smokestacks in the centre, construction cranes, distant towers fading in
haze. The air is dense and humid, thick with summer haze: each plane of depth
dissolves progressively — the foreground road is darker and contrasty with
crisp detail, the mid-ground softens, and the far city melts into a bright
luminous veil, silhouettes barely separating from the glowing sky. A soft
atmospheric glow blooms over the scene: the hazy sunlight scatters in the
thick air, the pale sky bleeds light over the skyline edges, distant windows
and car roofs catch faint glimmers, and a gentle bloom halos the brightest
patches of asphalt and the horizon. Aerial perspective washes the far planes
toward pale warm grey. Pale hazy white sky, no clouds, soft diffused summer
daylight, high horizon line, deep linear perspective.

Composition in the frame: three value planes. The mid block is the broad grey S-curving highway sweeping through the centre of the frame — the main shape, snaking from lower-left up to the right. The dark block is the deep-green forested mountainside massing down the right side and across the mid-ground as the darkest mass, with the steep grassy cut-slope on the left. The eye is led along the curving ribbon of road from the foreground bend up through the switchback to the escape ramp on the right, then out to the misty city and lake in the far distance. Off-center: the road's main curve holds the centre-left, the escape ramp and its blue sign anchor the right, the bright valley sits high and small.

The highway is a wide multi-lane divided road with a central barrier and painted lane lines, curving in a long S-bend as it descends the mountain, guardrails along both edges, painted directional arrows and faint Korean road markings on the tarmac. Branching off to the right and climbing steeply uphill is a runaway-truck escape ramp — a straight gravel-and-grid arrestor lane rising against the slope with red-and-white barrier markers at its top and a wall behind it. A blue overhead highway sign on a pole marks the ramp. A few small vehicles are scattered on the road — a couple of cars and a small three-wheeled cart — tiny against the scale. On the left a steep grassy embankment with a terraced concrete retaining wall rises beside the road; on the right and beyond, dense dark-green forested hills roll away. Far below and in the distance, a hazy valley opens up with a reservoir lake, a distant town and layered blue mountains fading under a pale overcast sky. Cool, soft daylight over the whole scene, the empty road winding down toward the misty distance.

Stylized 3D CG concept render: real 3D geometry with simplified, slightly rounded and chunky forms, softened edges and bevels, clean readable shapes over micro-detail. It is unmistakably a ninja costume, not a dress: no gown, no skirt, no bridal garment on the body. Covered completely from head to toe — no skin visible anywhere except a narrow horizontal band around the eyes.

Hands — fitted white gloves with separate fingers, no bare skin.

Trousers — loose ninja hakama-style trousers through the hip and thigh, draping in soft vertical folds, tapering below the knee and gathered into tight white wrappings around the calves and ankles.

Head — a white ninja hood covering the entire skull, neck and lower face, close-fitting, no hair showing at all. A fitted white cloth mask across the nose, mouth and jaw.

A bridal veil of sheer white tulle fixed at the crown of the hood beneath a small circlet of tiny white fabric flowers — the only bridal element, worn over the ninja hood. No nose, mouth, ears or hair visible.
No weapons of any kind.

RENDERING:
Clean crisp contour lines around every form, flat ivory fills with soft grey shading in the folds, the veil as thin translucent layers, fair skin only in the eye band.

BACKGROUND:
A single flat pale cream field behind all three views, no floor, no props, no text, no labels. A soft faint grey smudge of shadow under each standing figure. Even light from the front.

Wide horizontal frame, three views evenly spaced with generous margins top and bottom.
